verdict.rationale: Medusa has a dedicated Product Module (medusa-docs-21), and its framework is pitched as customizable and extensible (medusa-gh-1, medusa-docs-36), which implies the catalog model is not a fixed template. However, the pack never describes variants or options. A 2021 community comment (medusa-comm-9) says metadata appeared on orders but not on products. That comment is old and contradicts no specific vendor claim, so it is not a dispute. missing for 10: explicit documentation of product variants and options, documented custom fields/metadata on products, any hands-on corroboration of flexible catalog modeling.
